definitions.explanation: A warm golden-brown color resembling ripe wheat. Often used to describe sun-tanned skin or hair color.

examples.japanese: {麦色|むぎいろ}の{肌|はだ}が{健康的|けんこうてき}だ。
{夏|なつ}の{終|お}わりには、{子|こ}どもたちはみんな{麦色|むぎいろ}に{日焼|ひや}けしていた。
examples.english: By the end of summer, all the children had tanned to a golden brown.

examples.japanese: {麦色|むぎいろ}の{髪|かみ}をした{女性|じょせい}がカフェに{座|すわ}っていた。
examples.english: A woman with wheat-colored hair was sitting in the café.

notes:
Composed of {麦|むぎ} (wheat/barley) and {色|いろ} (color). A poetic and evocative color word frequently used in literature and everyday description. The most common usage is to describe a healthy, sun-tanned complexion, especially in summer contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {麦色|むぎいろ}の{肌|はだ}: wheat-colored skin, sun-tanned skin
- {麦色|むぎいろ}に{焼|や}ける: to tan to a golden brown
- {麦色|むぎいろ}の{髪|かみ}: wheat-colored hair

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {小麦色|こむぎいろ}: wheat color — nearly synonymous but more commonly used for describing tanned skin
- {黄金色|こがねいろ}: golden color — brighter and more vivid than wheat color
- {褐色|かっしょく}: brown — a more neutral, less poetic term for dark skin tones
